body:
This PR:
- Sets snow sedimentation velocity to Chen 2022 with snow apparent density = 300 g/m3
- Sets rain sedimentation velocity to fixed (temporary fix in hopes of improving the stability, needs more testing)
- Changes the config flags logic for sedimentation velocity choices for 1M species
title: Add a Chen 2022 snow fall-speed mode

## Purpose 
<!--- One sentence to describe the purpose of this PR, refer to any linked issues:
#14 -- this will link to issue 14
Closes #2 -- this will automatically close issue 2 on PR merge
-->
The SGS covariance cache adds two estimates of the same vertical displacement in the boundary layer: the turbulent block (`2 c l_mix² (∂_z ψ)²`) and the part of the geometric (resolved-gradient) block that needs a vertical displacement. This PR combines the two as the larger of the two estimates instead of their sum.
